title: Reviewed Observation Is Not An Admitted Series
summary: A map separating intake, first review, independent second review, revision lineage, break adjudication, series admission, and bounded outcomes.
map_question: What decisions remain between a structurally complete observation packet and an admitted compatible series?
interpretation_boundary: The path is governed and non-automatic. First review, second review, revision lineage, break adjudication, series admission, and outcome interpretation are separate human decisions.

nodes.label: Complete observation intake
nodes.note: All eighteen fields are structurally present; no Phase 70 intake exists.

nodes.label: First human review
nodes.note: One authorized reviewer decides twelve dimensions.

nodes.label: Independent second review
nodes.note: A different reviewer records agreement, conflict, recusal, or hold.

nodes.label: Revision lineage
nodes.note: Versions, corrections, supersessions, and withdrawals remain append-only.

nodes.label: Break adjudication
nodes.note: Visible breaks produce compatibility, segmentation, bridge, hold, or rejection decisions.

nodes.label: Accepted observation
nodes.note: A bounded receipt and complete propagation follow the dual-control decision.

nodes.label: Admitted compatible series
nodes.note: Eight admission gates require an independent human decision; no series is admitted.

nodes.label: Bounded outcome interpretation
nodes.note: Admission does not create a trend, comparison, causation, or outcome.

links.note: All thirty-two review dockets await a real submission.
Accepted and rejected versions require append-only lineage.
Revisions may create or disclose a series break.
One accepted observation cannot automatically admit a series.
Series admission is not outcome proof.

what_this_map_supports: Separate public contracts for intake, dual review, lineage, break adjudication, observation acceptance, and series admission.
Fail-closed conflict, recusal, correction, propagation, and forced-continuity handling.
Reader-visible empty control state before real evidence returns.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not establish that a submission, review, accepted observation, revision, receipt, or series exists.
It does not convert contract-present identity into an evidence value.
It does not create a trend, score, rank, comparison, forecast, causation, or outcome.
next_records_needed: A real same-entity artifact satisfying one Phase 69 specification and intake envelope.
Two independent review records with conflict and break handling.
A bounded observation decision receipt before any series-admission review.
